text:
inc-bot: ALERT: High p99 latency observed for /v1/chat/completions across us-west-2. Current p99=1.8s (baseline ~0.6s). Pager sent to on-call. Incident ID: INC-20260315-78

mia_oncall: seeing it. I'm taking the pager. Starting triage — collecting recent deploys and traffic shift.

raj: FYI no code deploys in last 30m. Traffic spike from a large customer hitting long-context chat threads. Also KV cache miss rate spiked ~20%.

sophia: linking perf dashboard: https://dash.redwood-infra/internal/d/latency/chat-completions?var-region=us-west-2

leo: quick check — autoscaling healthy, GPU utilization normal on the serving fleet. Suggest looking at model-level breakdown (mistral-v3 vs gpt-compat).

mia_oncall: running per-model query now. `curl -s "https://metrics.api/latency?route=/chat/completions&window=5m&by=model"`

analytics-bot: Results: mistral-v3-medium p99=2.1s (55% of requests), gpt-compat-small p99=0.7s (30%), rerankers p99 unaffected. KV cache hit-rate dropped from 92% -> 68% in last 10m.

emily: can we route new traffic to gpt-compat-small as short-term fallback? We have capacity in other pools.

mia_oncall: will try a routing policy override to route 40% of new requests for that customer to gpt-compat-small. Applying `route.override(customer=acct-44, target_model=gpt-compat-small, percent=40)`.

deploy-bot: NOTE: route override applied by mia_oncall at 2141598987.

raj: mitigation looks good — p99 for the customer subtraffic dropped to ~0.9s after routing change. Overall p99 down to 1.2s.

mia_oncall: live mitigation: 1) route 40% -> gpt-compat-small 2) temporarily increase KV cache capacity on mistral pool (warmed nodes) 3) silence noisy p99 alerts for the global chat route for 30m to avoid pager storms while we stabilize.

sophia: agree re: alert silencing for global p99. But we should not silence per-route critical alerts — create a scoped silence for `alert=chat_completions_p99` with `scope=global` and annotation `temporary_mitigation`.

mia_oncall: created silence: `alertctl silence add chat_completions_p99 --duration=30m --note="mitigating with routing override and cache warm-up"` (2141599043).

leo: note — we should adjust thresholds post-incident. Current single-threshold approach is noisy. Proposal: add per-model p99 thresholds and per-route p95 thresholds. Example rules:
```
- alert: ChatCompletions_P99_MistralV3
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/chat/completions", model="mistral-v3-medium"}[5m])) > 1.5
  for: 2m
- alert: ChatCompletions_P95_Global
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/chat/completions"}[5m])) > 0.5
  for: 5m
```

emily: also add a contention metric on KV cache misses as a noisy filter. Only fire model p99 if kv_miss_rate < 10% OR kv_miss_rate change is <5% in 10m.

analytics-bot: Suggested alert rule diff prepared: https://git.redwood/repo/infra-alerts/+/diffs/INF-4321.

mia_oncall: agreed. I'm opening post-incident ticket INF-4321 to formalize: per-model p99, per-route p95, KV-miss gating, a dashboard tile for customer-level tail latency, and runbook updates. Assigning to sophia+leo.

sophia: will pick up alert rule PR and dashboard changes. Plan to have PR by EOD.

leo: I'll add a small playbook section for temporary routing overrides and how to check cache warmup.

raj: For immediate noise reduction, I propose changing alert evaluation windows: p99 window -> 3m for model alerts, p95 -> 10m for global route to reduce flicker from short spikes.

mia_oncall: logged the temporary thresholds and actions in incident notes. We're at p99=0.8s overall. Rolling to monitoring->postmortem.

inc-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation applied, incident state -> RECOVERED (2141601320).

mia_oncall: handoff to follow-up owners: sophia (alerts+dashboards), leo (runbook+playbook), raj (postmortem & traffic analysis). I'll create a short blameless postmortem doc and link INF-4321 in the ticket.

emily: small customer impact note: a subset of long-context sessions saw increased latency for ~18 minutes before routing override. No data exfiltration. Notified customer success.

mia_oncall: closing live thread. We'll reconvene in the follow-up channel after postmortem draft. Thanks team :thumbsup:

analytics-bot: Post-incident suggested thresholds summary:
- global route p95: 0.5s (10m)
- mistral-v3-medium p99: 1.5s (3m)
- gpt-compat-small p99: 1.0s (3m)
- KV-miss gate: alert suppressed if kv_miss_rate > 10%

sophia: noted. Adding to INF-4321 checklist.

mia_oncall: last note: please review rollout plan for thresholds — we should stage in prod in 3 stages: canary (5% routes), small fleet, global. I'll coordinate with infra tomorrow.

leo: ack.

(reacts: :white_check_mark: by sophia, :eyes: by raj)
